basics.title: Senior Marketing & CRM Specialist
basics.tagline: Brand strategy, digital marketing and customer loyalty
basics.summary: Experienced marketing specialist passionate about brand strategy, digital marketing and customer loyalty. With international experience across Europe and the Middle East, I excel at designing and managing multichannel campaigns that deliver measurable growth. I bring strategic vision, rigorous execution and a results-oriented approach to turn business objectives into concrete, impactful marketing actions.

experience.role: Senior Marketing & CRM Specialist, France and Benelux
bullets: Developed and implemented regional marketing strategies across France and Benelux (3,047 retail locations, $7B annual revenue).
Deployed regional CRM strategies that increased customer engagement by 15%.
Managed end-to-end CRM campaigns: briefing, execution, optimization and reporting.
Coordinated with global brand, product, legal and media teams to maximize campaign impact.
Translated business objectives into customer-focused marketing actions that generated engagement and loyalty.
Identified growth opportunities that strengthened Western Union’s market-leading position.
Led marketing operations for a leading Middle Eastern cosmetics brand (127 stores, $24.9M revenue).
Launched integrated campaigns that doubled year-over-year sales.
Created media kits and worked with PR agencies to generate record coverage.
Conducted strategic market analysis to identify new business opportunities.
Managed digital engagement and improved user experience across multiple platforms.
Consistently achieved campaign KPIs while improving customer experience.
Named Employee of the Year for exceptional performance.
Developed and executed digital strategies for luxury brands (Rolls-Royce, BMW, Jaguar and Mini).
Strengthened digital visibility and engagement for premium automotive brands.
Managed social media for major accounts (Nesma Holding, Nesma Airlines and Saudi National Bank).
Built and grew digital communities, strengthening brand visibility and loyalty.
